BLV.description.source: Massed levies who loose arrows by the bucket and hope some land.
BLV.description.target: Levas en masa que disparan flechas a cubos y esperan que alguna acierte.

RBL.description.source: A mob with pitchforks, torches and strong opinions.
RBL.description.target: Una turba con horcas, antorchas y opiniones firmes.

HRD.description.source: A shambling multitude that wins by simply being too many.
HRD.description.target: Una multitud tambaleante que gana por ser demasiados.

ARC.description.source: Trained bowmen who shoot straight and keep their distance.
ARC.description.target: Arqueros entrenados que disparan recto y guardan la distancia.

LFT.description.source: Nimble foot who fight in loose order from cover.
LFT.description.target: Infantería ágil que combate en orden abierto desde la cobertura.

LSP.description.source: Loose-order spearmen, quick on their feet and on rough ground.
LSP.description.target: Lanceros en orden abierto, rápidos en terreno difícil.

RDR.description.source: Plunderers who hit hard, grab what they can and run.
RDR.description.target: Saqueadores que golpean fuerte, cogen lo que pueden y huyen.

SKM.description.source: Scouts and slingers who pester and are gone before the charge lands.
SKM.description.target: Exploradores y honderos que hostigan y desaparecen antes de la carga.

WBD.description.source: Wild warriors who charge in a howling rush.
WBD.description.target: Guerreros salvajes que cargan entre aullidos.

ART.description.source: Engines that hurl bolts, stones or worse.
ART.description.target: Ingenios que lanzan virotes, piedras o cosas peores.

EFT.description.source: Veteran foot, the finest blades in the host.
EFT.description.target: Infantería veterana, las mejores hojas de la hueste.

HFT.description.source: Armoured foot who hold their ground with axe and shield.
HFT.description.target: Infantería acorazada que aguanta con hacha y escudo.

PAV.description.source: Crossbows or bows sheltered behind tall shields.
PAV.description.target: Ballestas o arcos tras escudos altos.

PIK.description.source: A hedge of long pikes, deadly while it keeps its shape.
PIK.description.target: Un seto de picas largas, letal mientras mantiene la forma.

SPR.description.source: A wall of shields and spears, the backbone of many a host.
SPR.description.target: Un muro de escudos y lanzas, espina dorsal de muchas huestes.

WRR.description.source: Fighters without drill, strong in the first clash.
WRR.description.target: Combatientes sin instrucción, fuertes en el primer choque.

BAD.description.source: Riders on beasts nobody else would mount.
BAD.description.target: Jinetes sobre bestias que nadie más montaría.

BTX.description.source: Mounts that carry foot soldiers to the fight and leave them there.
BTX.description.target: Monturas que llevan a la infantería al combate y la dejan allí.

CHT.description.source: Chariots that race in, shoot and wheel away.
CHT.description.target: Carros que llegan, disparan y dan media vuelta.

ECV.description.source: The best-mounted riders, fighting in close order.
ECV.description.target: Los jinetes mejor montados, en orden cerrado.

HBW.description.source: Riders who shoot from the saddle and never quite close.
HBW.description.target: Jinetes que disparan desde la silla y nunca llegan a cerrar.

JCV.description.source: Light riders who throw javelins and wheel away.
JCV.description.target: Jinetes ligeros que lanzan jabalinas y se retiran.

KNT.description.source: Armoured riders who charge knee to knee.
KNT.description.target: Jinetes acorazados que cargan rodilla con rodilla.

CAT.description.source: Riders armoured head to hoof, mount included.
CAT.description.target: Jinetes acorazados de pies a cabeza, montura incluida.

ELE.description.source: Great beasts that trample what they cannot frighten.
ELE.description.target: Grandes bestias que pisotean lo que no logran asustar.
